posts.title: 27 Years Old
posts.description: From the 23rd June 2025 to 23rd June 2026. I’ve been spending less time in England during the summers as of late, so I went back to my roots and spent more time in and around London, with the occasional camping trip. I love England in the summer and would rather spend time escaping it during the winters!
